claim_boundary: Exact local pure-function workload over the checked-in 14,841-title catalog only; production invocation frequency, D1 and network latency, browser responsiveness, field devices, and retained-heap impact are unverified.

flow.name: scales taste recommendations across the checked-in catalog

harness_correction.observed: A static 16 MB JSON import was transformed by Vite in both the parent and test worker. The exact one-worker process tree independently peaked at 5624201216 bytes; CodeVetter's three-pass median stayed at 5752242176 bytes.
harness_correction.one_worker_was_not_the_cause: The pre-bound median was 5774032896 bytes and the one-worker replay remained 5752242176 bytes.
harness_correction.change: Read and parse the same checked-in catalog inside the test worker before the timed operation instead of statically importing it through Vite.
harness_correction.claim: This is benchmark-harness correction, not an Anime product memory or latency improvement.

change.summary: During the positive-limit catalog scan, compute only rounded taste score and retain bounded anime/score pairs; materialize the public recommendation objects, genre/theme arrays, and reason arrays only for final winners.
change.unchanged_path: The existing limit <= 0 path remains unchanged.

codevetter_accuracy_improvement.fixed_topology: Every exact Vitest pass now uses one fork worker with file parallelism disabled.
codevetter_accuracy_improvement.large_fixture_admission: Contained relative static JSON imports above 1 MiB remain visible but receive a large_static_json_fixture_signal and cannot enter autonomous execution. Metadata is inspected without reading fixture contents.
codevetter_accuracy_improvement.small_fixture_boundary: Contained static JSON fixtures at or below 1 MiB remain eligible.
codevetter_accuracy_improvement.result: The corrected harness retained the same actionable scoreAnime finding while reducing evaluator RSS from multi-gigabyte amplification to a bounded local process tree.
